many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

g=[[7,7,3,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7],

[7,7,7,2,7,7,3,2,7,7,3,2,7,7,7,2,7,3,7]]
hsep=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(c==2 for c in r)]
vsep=[j for j in range(19) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(8))]
bands=[i for i in range(8) if i not in hsep]
cols=[j for j in range(19) if j not in vsep]
bands=[b for k,b in enumerate(bands) if k==0 or bands[k-1]!=b-1]
rgroups=[]
for j in cols:
    if not rgroups or rgroups[-1][-1]!=j-1: rgroups.append([j])
    else: rgroups[-1].append(j)
markers=[(i,j) for i in bands for j in cols if g[i][j]==3]
from math import gcd
out=[[7]*len(rgroups) for _ in bands]
for a in range(len(markers)):
    for b in range(a+1,len(markers)):
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=markers[a],markers[b]
        dr,dc=abs(r1-r2),abs(c1-c2)
        if (dr==0 and dc<=2) or (dc==0 and dr<=2) or (dr==1 and dc==1) or (dr==1 and dc==2) or (dr==2 and dc==1):
            out[bands.index(r1)][rgroups.index([x for x in rgroups if c1 in x][0])]=1
            out[bands.index(r2)][rgroups.index([x for x in rgroups if c2 in x][0])]=1
print(out)
